verdict.rationale: LibreOffice documents headless `--convert-to` conversion with filter-name syntax, and its filter list includes an SVG export filter (writer_svg_Export). That gives first-party evidence of output to one listed image format. Nothing shows conversion among the other common image formats or any quality, size, or compression controls. Missing for 10: documented PNG/JPEG/WebP/HEIC conversion, image-to-image conversion (vs. document export), quality/resolution/compression parameters, and hands-on corroboration.
